name: County Durham
description: County Durham is a county in North East England centred on the historic city of Durham and its cathedral. It combines a largely rural interior and former mining communities with more urban areas along the River Wear and Tees.

places.name: County Durham
places.description: A large rural county in northeast England, home to Durham Cathedral, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the finest examples of Norman architecture in Europe.

places.name: Darlington
places.description: A market town in County Durham with a well-preserved Victorian centre, historically a railway engineering hub as the birthplace of the Stockton and Darlington Railway.

places.name: Hartlepool
places.description: A historic port town on the northeast coast, with maritime roots stretching back to a 7th-century monastery, now home to the National Museum of the Royal Navy's HMS Trincomalee.
